job.title: Senior Javascript/Typescript Developer
job.pay_full: $92,250 – $125,000 a year base salary, plus incentives tied to individual and company performance

details.about: Concentrix is a global technology and services company that works with major brands on customer experience. This role sits in the Web Engineering team of its Technical Products and Services group, supporting a strategic digital modernization initiative to improve customer-facing digital experiences: designing, building and deploying scalable web applications with modern front-end technologies and cloud-native practices, alongside architects, product owners, UX and platform engineers.
duties: Work with Product, UX and Architecture teams to build customer-facing features and enhancements
Develop reusable UI components, design system integrations and front-end frameworks
Integrate with internal and external APIs, microservices, authentication platforms and customer data services
Drive code quality through peer reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and engineering best practices
Optimize performance, accessibility, SEO, security and scalability
Take part in Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, backlog refinement, design reviews and retrospectives
Mentor junior developers and contribute to engineering standards and technical decisions
Support production deployments, troubleshooting and continuous improvement, working with platform and DevOps teams
needs: 3+ years of modern JavaScript application development
Experience building applications deployed in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or GCP
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Strong knowledge of web accessibility, WCAG and SEO best practices
A test-driven, quality-focused approach, with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Jest or Vitest
Strong debugging and performance tuning skills
nice: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and migration strategies
Design systems and reusable component libraries
AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor
details.benefits: Base salary $92,250 – $125,000 a year, plus incentives tied to individual and company performance; actual pay depends on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience and competencies. Benefits for eligible employees include medical, dental and vision insurance, an employee assistance program, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid learning days.
notes: Hybrid role; the posting lists Overland Park, KS in its heading and the Lenexa, KS business park as the work location
An existing, immediate vacancy: the employer wants someone who can start as soon as possible
Only applicants legally authorized to work in the US, with a valid US residential address, will be considered
